title: Verify Administrator can create a work order note and edit or delete their own note
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Administrator role. (viewing, creating, and editing/deleting your OWN note is gated by Work Orders: View per spec v33).
At least one work order exists.
steps:
1. Open a work order and go to the Notes tab.
2. Click to add a new note, type "Admin test note", and save.
3. Edit the note you just created, change the text to "Admin test note - edited", and save.
4. Delete the note you just created and confirm.
expected:
Step 1: The Notes tab opens and existing notes are visible.
Step 2: The new note is created and appears in the list.
Step 3: The edit saves and the updated text is shown.
Step 4: The note is deleted and removed from the list.
